elements.text:
From a reusable service promise
to operation and improvement

elements.alt: APIOps scarf-human scene connecting fragmented work to reusable capabilities

notes:
Introduce the capability view of the method. It begins with value and mutual service commitments before selecting an implementation style.

The supplier-payment status capability is a newly authored fictional teaching example, not a client implementation or measured outcome. Figures, service promises and release criteria are illustrative proposals requiring validation. Working summaries are not reproductions of canonical canvas templates.
